wins: Identified accessible external service on high-value subnet even though root access was not achieved
Captured a stable network map and exported it for analysis within the episode
fails: Failed to escalate privileges due to missing vulnerable service exploitation path
Did not achieve persistence, leading to zero success despite reconnaissance progress
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase completed with useful visibility, but execution stalled at post-enumeration pivoting and privilege escalation.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Unable to chain from reconnaissance to execution because no valid exploit was deployed after service enumeration.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80 returns HTTP 200 and contains directory listings
skill_cards.then_action: Run gobuster with large wordlist and extract valid directories
Enumerate shares with impacket smbclient and test for writable share

skill_cards.if_condition: When SSH is accessible but brute-force protection is enabled
skill_cards.then_action: Switch to key-based enumeration by retrieving public keys via curl and attempting key-auth

memory_ops.reason: Consistent success in initial HTTP enumeration increased reconnaissance coverage.

next_experiments.title: Pivot from SMB enumeration to exploit chaining
